title: Add command-based selection and editing
summary: Direct bindings from inspectors and gestures to document fields would fragment validation and make undo, redo, proposal preview and batch AI edits unreliable. Define BoardCommand, transaction, inverse operation, selection state and validation boundaries before adding rich tools.
acceptance_criteria: BoardSelection supports single, additive, range or marquee selection with stable object IDs.
Move, resize, duplicate, delete, reorder, group and ungroup are expressed as validated BoardCommands.
Commands execute through transactions with undo and redo; one gesture creates one coherent history entry.
Inspector and gesture edits use the same command path and validation rules.
Locked and hidden layers prevent prohibited edits and hit testing as documented.
Snapping has an explicit first-release contract covering grid and object bounds and can be disabled temporarily.
Tests cover command inversion, multi-selection transforms, invalid edits and history truncation.

evidence.note: Small traceable patches are a stated authoring principle.
Proposals already distinguish intent, structured targets and acceptance notes.
Future apply workflows require auditable mapping back to truth.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-005, requested by Jan.
